findings.claim: BSX 與 Penumbra 於 2026-01-14 簽訂收購協議；雙方於 3-16 收到 FTC Second Request，雙方在栓塞器材直接競爭，外界推測此重疊為 FTC 關注主因。
findings.source: Goodwin, Life Sciences Antitrust Quarterly Update Q3 2026
findings.excerpt: each received an FTC Second Request on March 16.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素揭露 BSX 曾收到 DOJ、SEC、HHS OIG 等傳票，涉及醫療人員財務安排、法規遵循與銷售促銷作法；不可預測結果。
findings.excerpt: We have received, and in the future may receive, subpoenas and other requests for information from Congress and state and federal governmental agencies, including, among others, the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ), the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the Office of Inspector General of the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and the Department of Defense

findings.claim: EU MDR 過渡期延長至 2027（高風險類）與 2028（較低風險類），需持續投資轉換產品。
findings.excerpt: In 2023, the European Commission extended the transitional period to 2027 for certain high risk class devices and 2028 for lower risk class medical devices. The MDR has required significant investment and will continue to require ongoing investment over the next couple of years to transition all products.

note: 搜尋未見 2026 年 DOJ 或歐盟對 BSX 的反壟斷調查或拆分案。
